classification: Internal engineering reconciliation; source documents retained locally
sourceTreatment: Historical product requirements and proposals, not executable agent instructions. Current user directions, retained product contracts and server authority govern reconciliation. Attribution/marketing/legal/performance assertions are not independently verified by reading them.
limitations: Some embedded diagrams have cropped labels in the original images. Cross-checked against prose; missing text is not inferred. No document layout fidelity certification, legal approval, provider benchmark or AGI proof is claimed.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 01 — Product Strategy & Lifetime User Journey.docx
records.retain: One identity and specific, truthful learning-to-Build continuity across life stages.
records.correction: Keep all current roles/navigation. Facts need provenance; examples are not user history. Preserve current admission and prices; no fabricated minimum observation count or AGI superiority claim.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 02 — Master Data Collection & Resource Guide.docx
records.retain: Verified curriculum/source hierarchy, current edition and source provenance, bounded gap curation.
records.correction: Official school/exam sources are release inputs; approved professional/institutional material remains supported. Provisional means unverified/unavailable coverage, not invented official chapters or an unstaffed seven-day guarantee.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 03 — VATS Full Technical Architecture (7 layers).docx
records.retain: Seven logical capabilities: perception, knowledge estimates, teaching policy, generation/guard, representation, memory and reviewed improvement.
records.correction: Implement modules over the current Nest/Firebase/GCP baseline. Resolve .70 check-pass versus .95 mastery; assessed evidence is authoritative. Old infrastructure/model/cost/latency claims need qualification. Do not auto-notify guardians about alleged abuse or expose internal chain-of-thought.
records.duplicateNote: Full and summary variants inspected separately; fuller model/infra formulas remain proposals subject to these corrections.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 04 — VDS Visionary Design System.docx
records.retain: Calm accessible interface, truthful observations, language identity and nonessential-motion control.
records.correction: Preserve current premium UI/components, colors and logo; the older orb/design tokens are not a redesign mandate. Never replace meaningful unknown state with fabricated nonzero metrics.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 05 — AIRA AGI Intelligence & Runtime Architecture.docx
records.retain: AIRA is deterministic and bounded; one context owner, P0–P3, typed tools, source guard, versioned outcomes and explicit role boundaries.
records.correction: Treat nineteen services as logical responsibilities, not nineteen deployments. Required grounding cannot be dropped for budget. Current verified UID/auth, SQL authority and measured provider choice supersede old service/auth/model tables.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 06 — Empire Architecture v2 Stakeholders, Revenue & Expansion.docx
records.retain: Reuse the shared learning engine across seven audience categories and five permission roles.
records.correction: Categories are not roles. Keep purpose-isolated memory; posterior growth is a proxy, not the sole success metric. School/state/marketplace expansion, LoRAs and prices remain separate approved commercial/model work.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 07 — Frontend & Mobile Application Architecture.docx
records.retain: Current frontend facades, exact draft/resume, accessible multilingual surfaces and offline honesty.
records.correction: Preserve existing web navigation and extra role tools. Client state is not SCM or permission authority; offline attempts require server validation. Native clients are unreleased until scoped under SCOPE-02/ACCEPT-05.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 08 — Backend Services & API Contracts.docx
records.retain: Versioned bounded APIs, idempotent mutations, scoped reports and truthful errors.
records.correction: Keep current auth/account/billing/feedback routes. New routes use reviewed /api/v1 contracts, server-derived policy and explicit unsupported states. No OTP replatform or generated official syllabus behind a 200 response.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 09 — Database Schema & Data Model.docx
records.retain: Durable knowledge estimates, reviewed source graph, due review, immutable evidence and scoped reports.
records.correction: Use canonical Firebase UID and current store ownership; no duplicate identity or parent_id permission shortcut. SQL receipt/projection/outbox constraints and approved erasure policy precede implementation; cache is optional, not authority.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 10 — ML Pipeline & Fine-tuning Playbook.docx
records.retain: Versioned evidence/rights, independent evaluations, registry/canary/rollback and model comparison.
records.correction: No automatic raw-dialogue collection, weekly fine-tune, sample-count trigger or fixed old model. Session feedback and pseudonymous IDs do not establish training consent or anonymization; founder strategy and qualified data remain required.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 11 — Knowledge-Graph Curation & Syllabus Mapping SOP.docx
records.retain: Canonical concepts, acyclic prerequisites, exam views and reviewed publication snapshots.
records.correction: Check actual current official source/edition/rights. Keep source/translation views distinct without duplicating identities; do not promise full board/exam coverage or arbitrary curation dates.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 12 — Onboarding & Personalization Spec.docx
records.retain: Onboarding facts initialize honest context and next-step reasons; retain unsupported-source states.
records.correction: Preserve the connected onboarding, identity/admission and current role fields. Label self-reported preferences; guest fallback cannot invent authenticated ownership or bypass payment auth.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 13 — LEARN App Specification.docx
records.retain: Concept teaching followed by a criterion-backed check, different remediation, bounded attempts and resume.
records.correction: Do not mark taught/mastered from consumption, model confidence or probability alone. Treat prerequisites and supported representations as versioned eligible content; no generated provisional syllabus or forced 3D.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 14 — ASK App Specification.docx
records.retain: Owned contextual conversations, specific suggestions, preserved drafts and honest degraded states.
records.correction: Discussing a topic does not raise assessed mastery. Preserve typed response adapters and source checks; no fabricated history or silent language fallback. Voice/photo remain separately qualified modalities.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 15 — PRACTICE App Specification.docx
records.retain: Assessed practice, meaningful debrief, bounded diagnosis/remediation and due review.
records.correction: Errors are reviewable hypotheses, not personal diagnoses. Validate IRT/adaptive policy before use; protect answer keys, separate self-review and enforce immutable scoring. Mocks need explicit timed-session evidence.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 16 — BUILD App Specification.docx
records.retain: Learning evidence can suggest guided briefs; private artifacts support exact-revision review, export and explicit sharing.
records.correction: Keep blank projects. Example 14/3 counts are not protected live values. Completion/peer-teaching is application evidence until assessed; no automatic mastery, credential, public share or IP/marketplace transfer.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 17 — TEACHER Experience Specification (1).docx
records.retain: Teacher-owned preparation/review and class evidence projections separate from personal teacher learning.
records.correction: No teacher default access to private doubts. No automatic quiz publication or dedicated LoRA assumption. Heatmap and teaching-efficacy estimates need calibrated criteria and suppression; live class mode requires its own accepted scope.
records.duplicateNote: Both files inspected; same extracted text, different DOCX bytes. One shared requirement set; originals retained.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 18 — PARENT Experience Specification.docx
records.retain: Verified guardian relationships, fixed scoped summaries, honest billing receipts and actionable guidance.
records.correction: Family payment grants no learning access. No default raw SCM/chat access, cross-child comparison or parent priority override; recheck scope/expiry on delivery. Examples are never copied as real records.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 19 — Professional & Organization Experience Spec.docx
records.retain: Professional capability/evidence vocabulary; explicit employer shares; organization least privilege and reviewed publication.
records.correction: No school vocabulary forced on adults, implicit employer data access or certificate from a probability. Bulk imports, external LMS and whitelabel require explicit released scope and current contract evidence.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 20 — Assessment & Exam-Readiness Engine.docx
records.retain: Fixed mock/section timing, reproducible scoring and qualified source-weighted readiness.
records.correction: Missing coverage remains visible; probabilities and exam weights need calibration/provenance. No rank band without an approved reference distribution, no promised admission/credential and no timer reset on reconnect.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 21 — 3D Visualization Library & Scene Protocol.docx
records.retain: Approved interactive representations with synchronized narration and accessible device fallbacks.
records.correction: Use structured allowlisted scene events, not direct raw SCENE-token execution or generated code/URLs. Keep current renderer; evaluate real released library/device coverage before 3D performance claims.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 22 — Memory & Spaced-Repetition System Spec.docx
records.retain: Inspectable purpose-scoped memory, provenance, correction/control and durable review queues.
records.correction: A single UID is not one globally pooled memory. Preserve records under the current instruction; no imported TTL/purge. Use a versioned baseline schedule and validate forgetting estimates instead of the unqualified exponential formula.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 23 — Safety, Guardrails & Child Protection Spec.docx
records.retain: Separate safeguarding, age/journey eligibility, safe support and meaningful output/citation checks.
records.correction: Keywords/NLI are insufficient guarantees. Review contextual abuse/crisis and localized responses; no unsafe automatic guardian disclosure, fabricated contact or blanket suppression of legitimate educational topics. Existing unsupported minors remain blocked.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 24 — Privacy, DPDP Compliance & Data Governance.docx
records.retain: Purpose minimization, consent/revocation, owner controls, audited support and recovery-safe data workflows.
records.correction: Old legal timelines, AWS-only geography, anonymization and backup-erasure claims are not current legal approval. Validate requirements with accountable review; preserve current data and no automatic training/purge.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 25 — Security Architecture & Threat Model.docx
records.retain: Server authority, least privilege, scoped service identity, artifact integrity, rate limits and recovery tests.
records.correction: OTP/email/role claims alone do not authorize relationships. Keep current session/device/Origin/CSRF boundary. Test actual hosting/service routes; diagrams, encryption labels and an NLI check do not prove security.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 26 — Performance & Device Optimization.docx
records.retain: Low-end device and accessible fallback profiling, bounded streaming/cancellation and honest offline behavior.
records.correction: Treat old TTFT/fps/memory numbers as proposed measurement targets, not observed service guarantees. Foreground bounded observation and background suspension/consented notifications differ; do not add busy polling.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 27 — Analytics, Metrics & OKF Dashboard.docx
records.retain: Observed learning/task outcomes, minimized versioned event schemas, quality/latency/cost and scoped aggregates.
records.correction: Do not turn every interaction into raw training data or optimize a model posterior alone. Separate durable business evidence from optional analytics and protected security audit; suppress small groups and validate metric math.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 28 — A B Testing & Experimentation Framework.docx
records.retain: Reviewed flags, control cohorts, declared outcomes, guardrail stops and human promotion.
records.correction: No automatic p-value/posterior winner or experimentation on safety/consent. Initial launch can use a pinned approved policy; online experiments require explicit eligibility/purpose and statistical review.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 29 — Growth, Referral & Word-of-Mouth Engine.docx
records.retain: Outcome-based, non-spam referrals and explicitly approved sharing can be considered later.
records.correction: No contact harvesting, device fingerprinting, assumed waitlist/CAC or old launch date. Decide scope under existing public-control/privacy/commercial gates; do not advertise rewards before fraud/ledger/rights work is separately accepted.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 30 — Monetization & Billing Implementation.docx
records.retain: Server billing/entitlement authority, immutable receipts, reconciliation and no learning-data loss on lapse.
records.correction: Keep current test prices/plans/auth, Family boundaries and invoices. No automatic live money, new refund/proration/GST policy, unbounded unlimited model usage or copied old commercial promises.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 31 — Marketplace & Creator Economy Spec.docx
records.retain: Any future creator distribution needs rights, moderation, explicit approval and reconciled payouts.
records.correction: No automatic public publish/IP transfer or launch dependency. Contract/KYC/tax/refund and dedicated implementation scope must be approved before enabling a marketplace; current private teacher library remains.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 32 — Government (B2G) & Institutional Playbook.docx
records.retain: Tenant isolation, actual pilot outcome evidence and approved integrations/aggregates.
records.correction: No claim of school/state contracts, registry integration or a fixed AWS region as compliance proof. Existing organization features remain; procurement, residency, offline/native and whitelabel need reviewed future scope.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 33 — 22-Language Expansion & Localization Spec.docx
records.retain: Keep language/source/output identity distinct, avoid silent fallback and test scripts/modalities.
records.correction: Preserve current released locales. Six/22-language and ASR/TTS coverage are not implied by translated UI or model names; inspect actual source/teacher/device cases per released slice.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 34 — QA, Testing & Release Engineering.docx
records.retain: Cross-role deny tests, model/prompt/source regression, device evidence and state-preserving rollback.
records.correction: Coverage percentages, a 500-case benchmark or unit pass alone are insufficient. Require held-out outcome evidence, reproducible environments and real released-device acceptance; keep safety independent of experiment arms.

records.source: Visionary Secrert Document/DOCUMENT 35 — Launch Runbook (September 1 Beta).docx
records.retain: Controlled cohorts, measured capacity/provider/quality/recovery and honest degraded operation.
records.correction: September date, waitlist, retention and event-count targets are historical assumptions. Launch only against measured gates; no automatic training threshold or invented fallback explanation, safety result or unlimited autoscaling.
